gameConfig.title: Neon Dash
gameConfig.description: A one-thumb neon runner: jump the pink spikes, slide under the amber beams, and grab coin arcs while the world accelerates under you.

sprites.name: runner
sprites.description: 34x46 neon cyan sprinter silhouette with a white outline and a trailing light streak

sprites.name: runner-slide
sprites.description: 44x24 crouched version of the runner, same cyan body, used during the slide

sprites.name: spike
sprites.description: 40x44 magenta hazard prism, sharp triangular point, white edge highlight

sprites.name: spike-wide
sprites.description: 64x30 low magenta block that must be cleared with a single long jump

sprites.name: barrier
sprites.description: 54x30 amber overhead beam suspended at head height; must be slid under

sprites.name: coin
sprites.description: 22px gold coin with a white specular highlight

sprites.name: shield-pu
sprites.description: 26px indigo shield orb with a soft outer halo

sprites.name: hill
sprites.description: 260x160 flat violet mountain triangle for the near parallax layer

sprites.name: hill-far
sprites.description: 340x210 darker violet mountain triangle for the far parallax layer

sprites.name: sky
sprites.description: Vertical gradient from purple at the top to near-black at the bottom, synthwave palette

audio.name: crash
audio.description: Falling sawtooth thud with a hard cutoff, 0.28s

audio.name: synthwave
audio.description: Driving 110 BPM synthwave loop with an arpeggiated bass and gated pad

keyboard: Space, Up or W to jump (press again for a double jump)
touch: On-screen JUMP and SLIDE buttons in the bottom corners

mechanics.name: Double jump
mechanics.description: Two jumps are available before touching the ground; the second is slightly weaker.
mechanics.implementation: jumps counter reset by the floor collider callback, capped at MAX_JUMPS.

mechanics.name: Timed slide
mechanics.description: Sliding shrinks the hitbox for 520ms to pass under beams; sliding mid-air becomes a fast drop instead.
mechanics.implementation: Texture swap plus body.setSize, auto-ended by a delayedCall timer.

mechanics.name: Speed ramp
mechanics.description: Scroll speed grows by 7 px/s every second, from 300 up to a 720 px/s ceiling.
mechanics.implementation: speed += SPEED_RAMP_PER_SEC * dt inside update(), clamped by Math.min.

mechanics.name: Reactive spacing
mechanics.description: Obstacle gaps shrink as speed rises so reaction time stays challenging instead of impossible.
mechanics.implementation: Gap range scaled by GAP_TIGHTEN raised to the current speed factor.

mechanics.name: Parallax scrolling
mechanics.description: Four tileSprite layers scroll at 0.12x, 0.28x, 1x and 1.4x world speed for depth.
mechanics.implementation: tilePositionX advanced by travel * layerFactor each frame.

mechanics.name: Coin arcs
mechanics.description: Coins spawn in three-coin arcs positioned to reward a well-timed jump.
mechanics.implementation: addCoinArc() places three pickups with a raised centre coin.

mechanics.name: One-hit shield
mechanics.description: Blue orbs absorb the next collision instead of ending the run.
mechanics.implementation: shield boolean consumed in the obstacle overlap handler before the death path.

monetizationHooks: Rewarded video to continue the run from the crash point
Interstitial ad every 3rd run on the game-over screen
320x50 banner slot reserved on the game-over screen
Coins bank into the shared meamus wallet for a runner-skin shop
Starter-pack IAP placeholder: permanent double-coin multiplier
mobileOptimizations: Phaser.Scale.FIT with CENTER_BOTH for any aspect ratio
Tap-anywhere jump so the game is playable with no on-screen chrome
Swipe-down gesture detection with a 40px / 400ms threshold
96px JUMP and SLIDE buttons in the thumb zones
tileSprite parallax instead of per-sprite scrolling to keep draw calls low
Obstacle and pickup pooling caps live bodies at 40
Loop sleeps and audio suspends when the app is backgrounded
